text:
Emma: Heads up — Globex AI disputed their May invoice. They say 20m were routed to fallback during a scheduled upgrade and they were charged burst rates. Asking for refund + SLA credit.

Ryan: can someone check commit attribution for 2026-06-01 03:40-04:00 UTC? customer says pool globex-ded-2 should have been used.

Zara: pulling logs now. quick find: routing table flipped to fallback-host for 18m due to a maintenance tag mismatch. Looks like committed allocation not honored.

Zara: snippet: ```assignments:
2026-06-01T03:43Z -> fallback-host
2026-06-01T04:01Z -> globex-ded-2```

Emma: estimate extra burst = $6,300. Globex requests cash refund + 7% SLA credit.

Finance-bot: Policy reminder: refunds > $5k need director + legal approval. SLA credits capped at 15% automatic, manual up to director.

Ryan: charge ids tied to window: CHG-11990, CHG-11991. Full recon in ticket #4290.

Helen: I'm okay with refund of the overcharged amount and a 7% SLA credit, given their 2-year commitment. Legal, please confirm contract allows refund.

Legal-bot: Contract SOW 3.1 permits "credit or refund" for failures to provide committed capacity. Recommend short amendment note.

Emma: action list: 1) prepare refund memo, 2) run refund command, 3) apply SLA credit to next invoice, 4) notify customer.

Zara: engineering fix deployed: maintenance tagging will now pin reserved pools during upgrades. ETA: already rolled, metrics look good. We'll add an event flag for billing reconciliation.

Helen: Approved. @emma please run `/process-refund CHG-11990,CHG-11991 amount=6300 ticket=4290 note="Globex AI - routing failover billing correction"` and log approval.

Emma: running command now and sending customer note: apology, corrected invoice, refund, SLA credit, and mitigation steps. Closing ticket #4290 after refund posts. :white_check_mark:
